name: What can cause paint to peel or chip prematurely?

mainEntity.name: What can cause paint to peel or chip prematurely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Premature paint peeling or chipping can be caused by several factors. Inadequate surface preparation, such as painting over dirt, grease, or a glossy surface without proper sanding, is a common culprit. Moisture intrusion, either from leaks, high humidity, or condensation, can also compromise paint adhesion. Using low-quality paint, applying paint too thinly, or painting in extreme temperatures can also lead to premature failure. Understanding the cause helps prevent recurrence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Paint peels or chips due to poor surface preparation, moisture, low-quality paint, thin application, or extreme painting temperatures.
